notes.title: Time Clickers is Officially 1 Year Old!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/mtYwHgy.jpg[/img]

We released the very first version on the Time Clickers website & Kongregate on March 20, 2015.

I was going to post a screenshot to show how much it changed in a year, but with a few exceptions (addition of the Artifact button) the main screen looks almost the same.

But there definitely were a lot of changes; adding Artifacts so people were no longer stuck at wave 125, adding Spec Ops so they could push even further, and we listened to the request for more weapons by adding the Click Launcher & Click Cannon. Plus there’s all the additional platforms (Steam, Android, iOS & WebGL) and the Cloud Save & Live Leaderboard to connect all the players together.

Happy 1st Birthday!

notes.title: Timeline Summary
notes.content:
[IMG] http://i.imgur.com/CBcrDx5.png [/img]

[h1]The Timeline Summary screen is now available![/h1]

Press the Time Warp button (after you've collected some Time Cubes) to view the new Timeline Summary Screen. The Timeline Summary includes stats like Most Maximum Damage, Fastest Run, Waves/Hour, Time Cubes/Hour, Weapon Cubes/Hour & Best Gold/Sec value.

Just a heads up, since we've added some new stats for update 1.4.2 there will be some compatibility issues between iOS and all other platforms. It just means that you'll lose your stats on the new Timeline Summary Screen if you play between iOS & other platforms until iOS gets the 1.4.2 update.

Try it out and let us know if there's any stats you think are missing from the Timeline Summary.

notes.title: Respec Update
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/WoEgx1u.jpg[/img]

After pressing Time Warp you'll now go into the new Respec screen where you can buy/sell Artifacts & Augments before starting your next timeline.

Left-click to Buy an Artifact/Augment.
Right-click to Sell an Artifact/Augment.
Hold down the mouse button to buy/sell multiple levels.
Mobile: Tap on Buy or Sell in the top right corner to switch between the 2 modes.

Press 'Start New Timeline' button when you're done, all changes take effect immediately.

Check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/385770/discussions/0/541907867753494410/]1.4.0 - Respec Update Change Log[/url] for all the details.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/GwggzVc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Respec FAQ[/h1]

[b]Why is Respec needed?[/b]
Accidental purchases, trying out different builds, not getting locked into one style of play, more freedom to experiment when balance changes are made.

[b]Will I lose Time Cubes or Weapon Cubes if I sell?[/b]
No. The sell price is 100% of the buy price. You will not lose anything.
 
[b]Why not allow buying & selling all the time?[/b]
The most effective strategy would be to put all your Time Cubes into Start Gold before Warping, then to take them all out and put them into other places after spending all the gold.

[b]Can you sell all of an Artifact or Augment that is a dependency of another one?[/b]
No, in that case you will need a minimum of 1 level, or sell all upgrades that are dependent on it.

[b]What if I don't want to change anything?[/b]
Just press 'Start New Timeline'

[b]Can I store builds so I can more easily swap between them?[/b]
Not at this time, it's a feature we could look at adding in the future. Let us know if you want this feature.

[b]Can I cancel and undo any changes I made?[/b]
Not at this time, this could be handled by having multiple Build Slots in the future.

[h1]What's Next...[/h1]
More stats! In addition to Gold per Sec, we want the Gold Widget to be a place where you can scroll through multiple stats. Some stats we were thinking of are Waves Per Minute, Time Cubes per Hour, Weapon Cubes per Hour, etc).

[img]http://i.imgur.com/8mqxUCU.png[/img]

Have you taken advantage of the ability to sell Artifacts/Augments, what do you think?
What additional stats would you like to have?

notes.title: Update 1.3 – Click Cannon Unlocked Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.3 - Click Cannon Unlocked is now available![/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HH2gg1g.png[/img]

Here are a couple of the requested features that are included in this update:

[h1]Click Cannon[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/sd5IDzz.png[/img]
The more you click, the more bullets it shoots. Costs 50,000 Weapon Cubes to unlock, and can upgrade Augments like Maximum Projectiles, Cone of Fire, & Flak Projectile Damage.

[h1]Overpowered[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/2Lg1VJu.png[/img]
The more you dominate an enemy, the quicker the next creature spawns & the shorter the fireworks will be. 

You can check out the full 1.3 change log [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/385770/discussions/0/541907867753494410/]here[/url].

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
Since 1.3 included a lot of big changes the next update will most likely be doing some more tweaks based on your feedback. So…
What do you think about Update 1.3? 
Do Time Cubes & Weapon Cubes feel more balanced now? 
Have you triggered Overpowered mode? Has it made Time Warping more fun?
Do you use the Gold OP when judging when to Promote your teammates?

notes.title: Update 1.3 – Click Cannon Unlocked Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.3 - Click Cannon Unlocked is now available![/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HH2gg1g.png[/img]

Here are a couple of the requested features that are included in this update:

[h1]Click Cannon[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/sd5IDzz.png[/img]
The more you click, the more bullets it shoots. Costs 50,000 Weapon Cubes to unlock, and can upgrade Augments like Maximum Projectiles, Cone of Fire, & Flak Projectile Damage.

[h1]Overpowered[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/2Lg1VJu.png[/img]
The more you dominate an enemy, the quicker the next creature spawns & the shorter the fireworks will be. 

You can check out the full 1.3 change log [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/385770/discussions/0/541907867753494410/]here[/url].

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
Since 1.3 included a lot of big changes the next update will most likely be doing some more tweaks based on your feedback. So…
What do you think about Update 1.3? 
Do Time Cubes & Weapon Cubes feel more balanced now? 
Have you triggered Overpowered mode? Has it made Time Warping more fun?
Do you use the Gold OP when judging when to Promote your teammates?

notes.title: Click Cannon Sneak Peek
notes.content:
Update 1.3 is still a work in progress, our focus lately has been on getting the Click Cannon added. It’s still in the early stages, but here’s a video where we walk through how it currently works.

https://youtu.be/F-pDHC5n2Ak
With the Click Cannon, the more you click, the more bullets per shot, the more damage you do! It currently starts out firing 1 bullet for every click, click more to power up and fire more bullets per shot. Stop clicking and it will cooldown, returning back to the 1 bullet per click.

While brainstorming on future updates we stumbled upon the interesting idea of an Official Twitch Plays Time Clickers channel. It would be a modified version of Time Clickers that changes to logic to allow Twitch Players to interact via Twitch Chat. You can get check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/385770/discussions/0/523897653302443806/]'Twitch Plays Time Clickers? Do you want it?'[/url] thread for more info. We’re looking for feedback so let us know what you think.

notes.title: Update 1.2 - Dual Wield a Rocket Launcher!
notes.content:
[h1] You asked for more weapons, so we’ve added the Click Launcher! [/h1]

[img] http://i.imgur.com/WDQrq17.png [/img]

Dual wield your Click Pistol & the new Click Launcher - which fires a powerful rocket every 10 clicks.

Want to shoot more than 1 rocket at a time? 
Want the Click Weapons to automatically fire? 
Wish you could speed up the Idle-Mode Targeting? 

Start collecting Weapon Cubes and spend them on Augments like these to make your Click Weapons even better.

You can check out the full 1.2 change log [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/385770/discussions/0/541907867753494410/] here [/url].

[h1] What's Next... [/h1]
Meet the Click Cannon. The more you click, the more bullets per shot, the more damage you do.

The Click Cannon will be in the next big update. We're using the Flak Cannon from Time Rifters (shown below) as inspiration.

[img] http://i.imgur.com/Oz5aQlh.gif[/img]

What do you think of the update? Any suggestions?

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Idle Mode Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/EtK50qE.gif[/img]

It's now easier to keep Time Clickers running in the background while you do other things like play Counter-Strike or Dota 2.

When the new Idle Mode is active you can:
[list]
[*] Automatically aim where your Pulse Pistol teammate is targeting
[*] Click to damage a targeted block, however this is slower & less efficient than manually aiming
[*] Click Rainbow Balls, collect gold & Time Cubes without turning off Idle Mode
[*] Easily toggle Idle Mode on/off
[/list]
Idle Mode won't shoot for you, but it's nice to know that it will be auto-aiming when your Maximum Damage bonus kicks in!

You can check out the full change log for update 1.1.0 [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/385770/discussions/0/541907867753494410/]here.[/url]

[b] What's Next [/b]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/385770/discussions/0/541907867790835197/] We're continuing to collect user feedback on the proposed Click Launcher, a secondary click weapon that you'd get when beating wave 1,000.[/url]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/G8FPtw7.jpg[/img]

You would dual wield both the Click Pistol & Click Rocket Launcher, with both weapons sharing your same crosshair. The Click Launcher has a low rate of fire, firing 1 rocket every 10 clicks of your Click Pistol. When using Idle Mode the Click Launcher will use the same target as your Rocket Launcher teammate.

What you think of the new Idle Mode?

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 - Balance & Bug Fixes Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/VoyaGxs.jpg[/img]

[b]Update 1.0.4 - Balance & Bug Fixes[/b]
- Max Spread Artifact raised from 5 to 10
- Added Dimension Shift visual/audio effect
- Save icon shows if you are connected to the Cloud or not
- Training renamed to 1.0, 1.1, etc.
- Cooldown time format is 0:00:00 now
- Balanced guaranteed Time Cube bosses
Wave/Cubes Before:
100/10 250/40, 500/100 1000/250 2000/600
Wave/Cubes After:
100/10 250/50, 500/200 1000/500 2000/1500, 3000/2500
- Time Cubes appear on top the black background but not the menus
- Fixed Augmented Aim tooltip on the Artifact description
- Removed malfunctioning ad network from mobile

Time Clickers is currently being featured on the App Store! Just a reminder you can [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/385770/discussions/0/541906989398650156/]Pair your Steam save and share it across multiple devices (Android, iOS & the web).[/url]

In another hilarious segment, [url=http://www.giantbomb.com/podcasts/giant-bombcast-08042015/1600-1304/]Giant Bombcast once again covered Time Clickers at the 54 minute mark in their latest podcast.[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/1SVVd0E.jpg[/img]

[b] Update 1.0.3 - Player Feedback Fixes [/b]
[list]
[*] Added Scientific Normalized Option. New toggle to switch between all 3 number display modes.
[*] Fixed offline cube destruction when your team is significantly more powerful than the arena HP.
[*] Fix Buy Max with Spec Ops. Icons refresh correctly. Achievement triggers.
[*] Alert messages are queued. Most useful for seeing how many Time Cubes you got. So it isn't over-written by the 'Boss Destroyed' message too quickly.
[*] Time Cubes appear on top of the black screen
[*] Balanced Defender Achievements (you keep any you earned in Steam before the balance change)
[*] Live Leaderboard stats are more accurate when importing or resetting
[*] Volume settings are preserved when doing a reset
[*] Active Ability hints refresh correctly when buying artifacts (fixed race condition)
[*] Fixed alert popup to show exponents correctly
[/list]

Listen to a funny conversation about Time Clickers and idle games on the [url=http://www.giantbomb.com/podcasts/giant-bombcast-07282015/1600-1300/] 07/28/2015 edition of the Giant Bombcast [/url]. Conversation starts around the 34 minute mark.

Looking for a great video walk through, check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLsBqca1-_w7D8gq3ao6oMjfWCyh2MHZTQ] Time Clickers Gameplay Guide by skyzm. [/url]
